Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a Washington state patrol retirement system deferred retirement option plan.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a Washington state patrol retirement systemdeferred retirement option plan; adding a new section to chapter 43.43RCW; providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCW,to be codified between RCW 43.43.120 and 43.43.320, to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The Washington state patrol retirement system deferredretirement option plan is created, as an alternative form of accrualunder the retirement system. Effective January 1, 2010, in lieu ofretiring under RCW 43.43.250 and accepting a retirement allowance underRCW 43.43.260, and either RCW 43.43.270 or 43.43.271, as applicable, anactive member of the Washington state patrol retirement system iseligible to participate in the Washington state patrol retirementsystem deferred retirement option plan if the member: (a) Is not ondisability status; (b) has at least twentyseven years of servicecredit, calculated as the sum of service credit recognized under RCW43.43.230, 43.43.233, 43.43.235, and 43.43.260; and (c) is eligible toreceive a retirement allowance. p. 1 SSB 5333 (2) A member of the Washington state patrol retirement system whois eligible to do so may begin participation in the deferred retirementoption plan on the first day of a month. A member who elects toparticipate in the Washington state patrol retirement system deferredretirement option plan shall: (a) Irrevocably elect a form of monthlyretirement allowance from the Washington state patrol retirementsystem; (b) continue employment with the Washington state patrol; (c)agree to the calculation of a deferred retirement option plan benefitunder this section in lieu of service credit or salary increaseadjustments that would increase the member's average final compensationduring the member's remaining period of service; and (d) identify adate certain that is (i) the last day of a month, (ii) not more thanfive years from the date that the member elects to begin participationin the Washington state patrol retirement system deferred retirementoption plan, (iii) when the member's employment with the Washingtonstate patrol terminates, (iv) when the member's participation in theWashington state patrol retirement system deferred retirement optionplan ends, and (v) the date after which the member begins receiving themember's retirement allowance. The member may designate, or change themember's designation of, a beneficiary who shall receive the balance ofthe accruals to the member's deferred retirement option plan accountcreated under subsection (3) of this section, in the event that themember dies during the member's participation in the deferred optionretirement plan option. The member shall make such a designation inwriting to, and in the manner prescribed by, the department ofretirement systems. If someone other than the member's spouse or stateregistered domestic partner is designated as the sole primarybeneficiary, then the member must also file with the department ofretirement systems a written statement from the member's spouse orstate registered domestic partner consenting to the beneficiarydesignation. (3) When a member elects to participate in the Washington statepatrol retirement system deferred retirement option plan, a deferredretirement option plan account is created for the individual member inthe fund of the retirement system. While the member is participatingin the Washington state patrol retirement system deferred retirementoption plan, an amount equal to seventyfive percent of the monthlyretirement allowance that would have been payable had the member SSB 5333 p. 2 retired and begun receiving a retirement allowance according to themember's election made under subsection (2)(a) of this section,adjusted for costofliving increases according to subsection (5)(c) ofthis section, shall be credited to the member's deferred retirementoption plan account. The member's deferred retirement option planaccount shall be credited on an annual basis with interest at a fixedrate of six and onehalf percent per year. (4)(a) The member forfeits the accruals under the deferredretirement option plan if the member terminates participation in theWashington state patrol retirement system deferred retirement optionplan before the date identified by the member pursuant to subsection(2)(d) of this section for any reason other than the member's death.If a member forfeits the amounts credited to the member's deferredretirement option plan account under this subsection (4)(a), then themember begins receiving the member's retirement allowance according tothe election made pursuant to subsection (2)(a) of this section. Themember's service credit in the Washington state patrol retirementsystem is not adjusted for the period of the member's participation inthe deferred retirement option plan, nor are salary increaseadjustments made to the member's retirement allowance for the periodduring which the member participated in the deferred retirement optionplan. (b) A member who, during the member's participation in the deferredretirement option plan, is placed on disability status in accordancewith RCW 43.43.040(1)(a), and receives compensation in accordance withRCW 43.43.040(2), is (i) deemed to have terminated participation in thedeferred retirement option plan on the last day of the month thatcoincides with, or next follows, the date of the member's placement ondisability status; and (ii) not entitled to the accruals under thedeferred retirement option plan, and instead receives the disabilitybenefit in accordance with RCW 43.43.040. (c) A member shall be reinstated in the Washington state patrolretirement system deferred retirement option plan, and the accrualbalance previously established shall be reinstated, on the first day ofthe month that coincides with or next follows the date that the memberresumes active duty employment with the Washington state patrol, if themember (i) received disability benefits under RCW 43.43.040; (ii) wasdeemed to have terminated participation in the deferred retirement p. 3 SSB 5333option plan; (iii) returns to active duty employment with theWashington state patrol; and (iv) resumes active membership in theretirement system. (d) Any member, who is placed on disability status during themember's participation in the deferred retirement option plan, whosedeferred retirement option plan account is not reinstated according to(c) of this subsection, shall not receive a monthly retirementallowance from the Washington state patrol retirement system. (5) While a member is participating in the Washington state patrolretirement system deferred retirement option plan, (a) the member andemployer contributions to the Washington state patrol retirement systemshall continue to be paid to the retirement system at the rate computedfor the current active members under RCW 41.45.0631; (b) the membershall not earn any additional service credit under the Washington statepatrol retirement system or receive any salary increase adjustments tothe member's retirement allowance calculation; (c) the member's accrualunder the deferred retirement option plan shall be credited withretirement allowance costofliving increases from the Washington statepatrol retirement system, up to a maximum of three percent per year. (6) At the earlier of the date of the member's death or the dateidentified by the member pursuant to subsection (2)(d) of this section,and subject to subsection (4) of this section, the balance of themember's deferred retirement option plan account shall be distributedpursuant to this subsection, and in accordance with federal law. (a) The member may elect to receive the accrual balance in themember's deferred retirement option plan account in (i) a lump sumpayment; or (ii) a direct rollover in accordance with federal law. (b) If the member dies during the member's participation in thedeferred retirement option plan, then the balance of the accruals inthe member's deferred retirement option plan account shall bedistributed to the member's designated beneficiary as a lump sum or adirect rollover in accordance with federal law, or if there is nodesignated beneficiary or the designated beneficiary predeceases themember, then to the estate of the member as a lump sum. Distributionof the member's deferred retirement option plan account balance underthis subsection (6)(b) is in addition to any death benefits payableunder any other statute. A member who receives a distribution pursuantto this subsection shall not earn any additional service credit under SSB 5333 p. 4 the Washington state patrol retirement system or receive any salaryincrease adjustments to the member's retirement allowance calculation,even if the member is subsequently reemployed by the Washington statepatrol.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2009.
